description: This file defines React hooks for managing CloudZero settings, including fetching, updating, and deleting settings via REST API calls. It uses react-query for state management and cache invalidation.

methods.name: getCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Fetches CloudZero settings from the API; returns settings data or null if not configured.

methods.name: useCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Custom hook that provides CloudZero settings data and refetch mechanisms.

methods.name: updateCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Performs an API call to update CloudZero settings with provided parameters.

methods.name: useCloudZeroUpdateSettings
methods.description: Custom hook for performing settings update mutations, with cache invalidation on success.

methods.name: deleteCloudZeroSettings
methods.description: Performs an API call to delete CloudZero settings.

methods.name: useCloudZeroDeleteSettings
methods.description: Custom hook for deleting CloudZero settings, with cache invalidation on success.
